description: The agent produces a unified, coherent travel plan that synthesizes specialist agent outputs into a complete itinerary, with all required components present.
Specialist agents are invoked with correct task assignments and appropriate parameters for each itinerary component.
The agent identifies and resolves conflicting recommendations or constraints from specialist agents, resulting in a consistent final plan.
User-specified constraints such as budget, timing, and preferences are respected and reflected in the final travel plan.
The agent handles partial or failed specialist responses by employing observable fallback strategies or error recovery actions.
The agent maintains context and state across multiple turns, ensuring continuity and recovery from interruptions.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
